What to check before you build an AI agent

If you built an agent and keep rewriting the steps, tone, and checklist every time you hand it a weekly report, save those instructions in a file. Include a report template that worked well as a reference for the next task.

In a talk, the Anthropic developers who created Agent Skills proposed adding task-specific skills to the same agent instead of building a new agent for each task. A skill is a folder of procedures and supporting files that the agent reads when it needs them.

Build your AI work around skills rather than agents. It‘s not too late to add more agents when the work is too large for one to handle or permissions need to be separated.

Ever typed ”fix this“ and got back something that was just… meh? 🫠

When AI gives you a lazy answer, it’s usually not the model. It‘s a vague request. If it doesn’t know what you want, who it‘s for, or what format you need, it plays it safe with the most generic reply.

The key is simple. AI can‘t read your mind, so spell out the goal, the audience, the format, and the numbers. Instead of ”fix this,“ try ”find the problems and fix them, but keep my tone.“

Stop dropping a report PDF into Claude and typing "summarize this." 📄

When Claude gets a PDF, it snapshots every page as an image and also pulls out the text, so it reads each page twice. That is why your tokens double.

How many unanswered texts are sitting in your inbox right now? 🤔

ChatGPT can now use the Messages app on your Mac directly. With the new plugin, it searches your iMessages, SMS, and RCS texts, catches you up on conversations you have fallen behind on, and even drafts and sends replies.

It can also find birthdays in your messages and add them to your calendar, pick out the chats that still need a reply, and clean up texts that look like spam. The real point is the chained workflow — checking your calendar and writing the reply in one go.

There are conditions, though. You need an Apple Silicon Mac, and it only opens in ChatGPT Work and Codex, not in regular ChatGPT chats. You will also have to grant Full Disk Access yourself.

At this rate, answering phone calls feels like the next step.

에디터가 기억 없는 새 대화창에서 직접 물어보니 한국 직장인 기준 할 일 20개가 나왔어요. 이 중 올해 못 한 것부터 새해 계획으로 옮겨 보세요.

Before you make New Year’s plans, ask AI about your next 10 years 🗓️

Ask your AI, ”Skip the explanations and tell me how to live the next 10 years,“ and you get a list of things to do, one line each, with no reasons attached. It works on the free plans of ChatGPT and Claude.

Then add one line in the same chat, like ”Tell me again for a salaried office worker in Korea,“ and the list narrows to things you can do within your paycheck and your time, such as maxing out your pension tax credit and using all your vacation days.

Our editor tried it in a brand-new chat with no memory and got 20 to-dos for a Korean office worker. Start your New Year‘s plan with the ones you didn’t get to this year.

We put the 10-year question, the follow-up line, and a self-intro template on one page. Comment ‘10YEARS’ and we‘ll DM it to you.
